title: More Spatial Relations - Distance & Proximity
description: Learn to describe distance and proximity: près de (near), loin de (far from), à côté de (next to), en face de (across from), autour de (around)
can_do: Describe distance and proximity (near, far from, next to)
Give detailed directions with spatial relations
Say 'The café is next to the park' in French

concepts.example: {Le café est près de l'école} (The café is near the school), {J'habite près d'ici} (I live near here)
{La gare est loin de la maison} (The station is far from the house), {C'est loin d'ici?} (Is it far from here?)
{Je suis à côté de toi} (I'm next to you), {Le restaurant est à côté du cinéma} (The restaurant is next to the cinema)
{Ma maison est en face du parc} (My house is across from the park), {Il est assis en face de moi} (He's sitting across from me)
{Les gens sont autour de la table} (People are around the table), {Autour de la ville} (Around the city)
{Le long de la rue} (Along the street), {On marche le long de la rivière} (We walk along the river)

concepts.term: {au milieu de} - in the middle of
concepts.example: {Au milieu de la place} (In the middle of the square), {Il est au milieu} (He's in the middle)

concepts.term: {au bout de} - at the end of
concepts.example: {Au bout de la rue} (At the end of the street), {C'est au bout} (It's at the end)

items.gloss: The café is near the school

mistakes.feedback: Loin de means 'far from'. Use '{près de}' for 'near/close to'!
Devant means 'in front of'. Use '{près de}' for 'near/close to'!

items.gloss: The station is far from the house

mistakes.feedback: Près de means 'near/close to'. Use '{loin de}' for 'far from'!
À côté de means 'next to'. Use '{loin de}' for 'far from'!

items.gloss: I'm next to you/I'm sitting beside you

mistakes.feedback: Près de means 'near' (general). Use '{à côté de}' for 'right next to/beside'!
Avec means 'with'. Use '{à côté de}' for 'next to'!

items.gloss: My house is across from the park

mistakes.feedback: À côté de means 'next to' (same side). Use '{en face de}' for 'across from' (opposite side)!
Devant means 'in front of' (blocking). Use '{en face de}' for 'across from' (facing)!
Sur means 'on top of'. Use '{autour de}' for 'around/surrounding'!
Près de means 'near' (close). Use '{autour de}' for 'around' (surrounding)!
Près de means 'near'. Use '{le long de}' for 'along' (following the length)!
Autour de means 'around' (circling). Use '{le long de}' for 'along' (following)!

items.gloss: The table is in the middle of the kitchen

mistakes.feedback: Dans means 'in' (general). Use '{au milieu de}' for 'in the middle of'!
Sur means 'on'. Use '{au milieu de}' for 'in the middle of'!

items.gloss: The restaurant is at the end of the street

mistakes.feedback: Dans means 'in/on' (general). Use '{au bout de}' for 'at the end of'!
Près de means 'near'. Use '{au bout de}' for 'at the end of'!

items.gloss: I live near here/I live close by

mistakes.feedback: Loin de means 'far from'. Use '{près de}' for 'near'!
Dans means 'in'. Use '{près d'ici}' for 'near here'!
Près de means 'near'. Use '{loin de}' for 'far from'!
À côté de means 'next to'. Use '{loin de}' for 'far from'!

items.gloss: The cinema is next to the restaurant

mistakes.feedback: En face de means 'across from'. Use '{à côté de}' for 'next to/beside'!
Dans means 'in/inside'. Use '{à côté de}' for 'next to'!

items.gloss: He's sitting across from me/facing me

mistakes.feedback: À côté de means 'next to' (same side). Use '{en face de}' for 'across from' (opposite)!
Devant works but '{en face de}' is more specific for facing position!

items.text: Il y a un jardin ___ maison
items.gloss: There's a garden around the house

mistakes.feedback: Dans means 'in/inside'. Use '{autour de}' for 'around/surrounding'!
Près de means 'near'. Use '{autour de}' for 'around' (all sides)!

items.text: Il y a des arbres ___ route
items.gloss: There are trees along the road

mistakes.feedback: Sur means 'on'. Use '{le long de}' for 'along' (following the length)!
Autour de means 'around' (surrounding). Use '{le long de}' for 'along'!

items.text: Il y a une fontaine ___ place
items.gloss: There's a fountain in the middle of the square

mistakes.feedback: Dans means 'in' (general). Use '{au milieu de}' for 'in the middle of'!
Sur means 'on'. Use '{au milieu de}' for 'in the middle of'!

items.gloss: The door is at the end of the garden

mistakes.feedback: Dans means 'in' (general). Use '{au bout de}' for 'at the end of'!
Près de means 'near'. Use '{au bout de}' for 'at the end of'!

items.gloss: The park is far from the city

mistakes.feedback: Près de means 'near'. Use '{loin de}' for 'far from'!
Dans means 'in'. Use '{loin de}' for 'far from' (outside)!
Avec means 'with'. Use '{à côté de}' for physical position 'next to'!
Près de means 'near' (general). Use '{à côté de}' for 'right next to'!
